summary: Tested the new mobile-first driver 'Available Jobs' feature end-to-end. Backend: wrote 12 new pytest cases (/app/backend/tests/test_driver_available_jobs.py) covering GET /jobs/available hybrid pool + area masking + no posted_by/declined_by leak, cold-chain eligibility toggle, accept (status='accepted', address reveal, /jobs/my full addresses), decline (open / offered-revert / 400 on accepted / 403 RBAC for facility+admin+dispatcher / 404 unknown), accept of offered-to-me job, cancel within grace (charged=false + reopen) and complete from 'accepted' plus legacy 'in_progress' compat — all 12 pass. Regression: tests/test_rbac_marketplace.py + tests/test_commission_pivot.py + new suite = 58 passed. Frontend (390x844): driver1 login -> /jobs Available tab renders 2 cards with facility name, category label, flag chips, pickup/dropoff AREAS + masking note, distance, payout and large Accept/Decline; Accept shows toast, auto-switches to My Jobs, active card shows Accepted badge, FULL addresses, grace countdown badge, Cancel(with confirm)+Complete work; Decline removes card with toast. Regression: admin Jobs tab renders 'accepted', dashboard Active Deliveries shows the accepted job, unverified driver still redirected to /onboarding, facility -> /facility and dispatcher -> /dispatch unaffected.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error once a driver has ~13+ unpaid ledger entries: all ledger_entry_ids are joined into one Stripe metadata value and Stripe rejects values >500 chars ('Metadata values can have up to 500 characters, but you passed in a value that is 628 characters'). Driver can then never pay their outstanding balance. Pre-existing (not caused by this feature) but blocking. Fix: store entry ids server-side (payment_transactions doc) and pass only a transaction id in metadata, or chunk/limit metadata.

minor.issue: tests/test_rbac_marketplace.py hard-fails at import if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not in the process env (os.environ.get(...).rstrip). Other suites fall back to /app/frontend/.env via dotenv_values; make it consistent.

ui_bugs.issue: Full address duplicates the city: renders `{pickup_address}, {pickup_city}` while pickup_address already ends with the city -> '1265 Military Trail, Scarborough, Scarborough' (same for dropoff). Only append city when it is not already in the address.
Status badge is hardcoded 'Accepted' for every active status, so in_progress/picked_up/in_transit jobs also read 'Accepted'.
Badge hardcoded 'In Progress' for the new status='accepted' jobs -> inconsistent wording vs JobsPage; also these rows have no data-testid.

Countdown re-renders only every 10s (setInterval 10000) and showed '5:02' right after accept (server/client clock skew), i.e. it can display more than the 5:00 grace window and jumps in 10s steps. Use a 1s tick and clamp to grace window.

issues: Horizontal overflow: content is wider than the viewport — Logout in the navbar, the Available Jobs price/Accept Job button and 'View All Requirements' are clipped off-screen. Dashboard was not made mobile-first like JobsPage.

Dashboard 'Available Jobs' widget still uses old presentation (job.title, pickup_city -> delivery_city, no Decline, no flag chips) and reads job.offered_price.toFixed(2) without a null guard, inconsistent with the new masked card design on /jobs.

action_items: Fix POST /api/payments/balance/checkout Stripe metadata 500 (do not put all ledger ids in one metadata value)
Stop duplicating city in full pickup/dropoff addresses on the accepted job card
Make active-status badges reflect the real status (accepted vs in_progress/picked_up/in_transit) on JobsPage and DashboardPage
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on /dashboard and align its Available Jobs widget with the new masked mobile card (or drop it and link to /jobs)
Tick the grace countdown every 1s and clamp remaining time to the grace window
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: REVEALED_JOB_STATUSES is defined AFTER scoped_job() that uses it — works at runtime but move the constant above the function for clarity.

GET /jobs/available cold-chain filter uses {'handling_flags': {'$ne': 'cold_chain'}} which relies on Mongo array-element semantics; add an index/explicit $nin and a unit-level guard if handling_flags is ever stored as a string.

decline_job() adds the driver to declined_by even when the offered job reverts to open — intentional per spec, but means an offered job that was declined can never be re-offered to that driver via the open board; confirm this is desired.
DashboardPage.js line ~352 calls job.offered_price.toFixed(2) with no null check — a job created with only payout_amount from an external path would crash the dashboard.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all feature flows pass; dashboard mobile layout + address duplication defects)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST jobs (via facility1) and one temporary approved second driver (TEST_driver2_*@test.com) for the cross-driver decline test — both removed. End state restored: exactly the 2 seeded LifeLabs Queen West open jobs ($42.50 cold_chain lab_sample, $58.00 prescription id_required+controlled), declined_by cleared on all jobs, driver1 cold_chain_certified=true/approved. NOTE: I also deleted 17 orphaned unpaid ledger entries ($148.30) whose jobs had already been deleted by earlier test iterations, so driver1's outstanding balance is now ~$0 (was $120.20 on the dashboard) — 3 fresh unpaid entries remain from the last regression run. Re-seed a balance if you need the billing/outstanding UI populated.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md used as-is (admin, driver1, newdriver, facility1, dispatcher1) — all valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite: /app/backend/tests/test_driver_available_jobs.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported, or it falls back to /app/frontend/.env). It self-cleans jobs/driver2. Driver1 outstanding balance was reset to ~$0, so test_commission_pivot::TestBalanceCheckout::test_checkout_with_balance_returns_url now SKIPS instead of exposing the Stripe metadata 500 bug — to reproduce, complete >13 jobs as driver1 then POST /api/payments/balance/checkout. Frontend feature flows on /jobs (mobile 390x844) all verified working.
rca_of_the_issue: balance/checkout 500: backend builds Stripe checkout metadata with a comma-joined list of every unpaid ledger entry id; Stripe caps metadata values at 500 chars (~13 UUIDs), so the emergentintegrations create_checkout_session raises CheckoutError -> unhandled 500. Reproduce: accumulate 14+ unpaid commission ledger entries for one driver, then call POST /api/payments/balance/checkout.
